Although the authors propose a strategy of re-estimating the posterior with pseudo labels, limitations remain, especially on heterogeneous graphs with sparse labels."

Does the comment explicitly mention a specific part? It mentions "the posterior label smoothing method" — which is a specific method (presumably a named method in the paper). This is analogous to mentioning a section/table/figure — the rubric says "explicitly mentions which part of the paper it addresses, or it should be obvious to the authors." The method name would be obvious to the authors. And it specifies what's wrong: reliance on neighborhood label distribution leading to unstable posteriors in sparse graphs, and limitations of the pseudo-label re-estimation strategy on heterogeneous graphs with sparse labels.

So gold label 5 seems appropriate. The comment names the specific method and details the issues.
